audience.text: Python developers needing deterministic, dependency-free MSG/CFB reading, writing, and conversion without requiring Microsoft Outlook or COM interop.

capabilities.text: Read Outlook MSG files using MapiMessage.from_file() and access message properties, recipients, and attachments.
capabilities.title: Read MSG files

capabilities.text: Create new messages with MapiMessage.create(), set properties, add recipients and attachments, and save to disk.
capabilities.title: Write MSG files

capabilities.text: Convert MSG messages to EML format via to_email_message() and serialize using EmailMessage.as_bytes().
capabilities.title: Convert MSG to EML

capabilities.text: Reconstruct MSG messages from EML using BytesParser and MapiMessage.from_email_message().
capabilities.title: Convert EML to MSG

capabilities.text: Inspect and build Compound File Binary containers using CFBReader, CFBWriter, CFBStorage, and CFBStream.
capabilities.title: Low-level CFB access

capabilities.text: Parse MSG property streams directly using MsgReader and MsgWriter for advanced inspection and manipulation.
capabilities.title: Low-level MSG access

capabilities.text: Set and get MAPI properties including named properties using PropertyId and MapiNamedProperty.
capabilities.title: MAPI property support

capabilities.text: Add regular and embedded-message attachments using MapiMessage.add_attachment() and MapiAttachment.
capabilities.title: Attachment handling

limitations.text: No mail server connectivity: IMAP, SMTP, and POP3 are not supported.
TNEF (winmail.dat) parsing and generation is not implemented.
No dedicated calendar or appointment API; calendar-specific MAPI properties must be accessed generically.
Direct .eml file parsing is not implemented; EML support requires Python's standard email.parser.

problems_solved.text: Enables reading and writing Outlook MSG files and CFB containers using pure Python without external native dependencies or Microsoft Outlook.
Provides bidirectional conversion between MSG and EML formats through integration with Python's standard email.message.EmailMessage.
Supports low-level access to MSG property streams and CFB directory structures for advanced inspection and manipulation.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Email FOSS for Python is a pure-Python, MIT-licensed library for processing Outlook MSG and Compound File Binary (CFB) formats, with two-way conversion to/from EML via Python's standard email package.

uncertainties: The exact scope of 'Outlook-oriented compatibility defaults' mentioned in the README is not fully detailed in the fact dossier.

Whether the library supports reading or writing MSG files with Unicode strings beyond the basic examples is not explicitly confirmed beyond the unicode_strings parameter in MapiMessage.create() and from_email_message().

workflows.name: Read MSG file
workflows.text: Load an MSG file using MapiMessage.from_file() and access message properties such as subject.

workflows.name: Create and save MSG
workflows.text: Create a new message with MapiMessage.create(), set properties, add recipients and attachments, and save as MSG.

workflows.name: Convert MSG to EML
workflows.text: Load an MSG file, convert to EmailMessage via to_email_message(), and write to .eml using as_bytes().

workflows.name: Convert EML to MSG
workflows.text: Parse an EML file using Python's BytesParser, then construct a MapiMessage via from_email_message() and save as MSG.

workflows.name: Inspect CFB structure
workflows.text: Use CFBReader to traverse storages and streams, or CFBWriter to build and serialize CFB containers.
